negotiations.title: Negotiations
negotiations.description: B2B price requests from signed-in customers, answered in one thread

demo.title: Demo mode
demo.body: Sample negotiations in every state. They never expire and never create draft orders or carts. Switch the demo option off in medusa-config.ts before going live.

messageType.added_to_cart: The agreed lines were added to the cart

move.noteHint: Internal notes never reach the customer: not in the Store API, not in customer events.
move.rejectHint: Rejecting ends the negotiation. The customer sees the reason.

floor.confirm: I confirm this price below the threshold

draft.title: Draft order
draft.hint: Plan, dry run, then the write: a draft order at the agreed price, once per negotiation.
draft.off: Draft orders are off in the plugin options (writers.draftOrders).
draft.notArmed: Draft orders are not armed. Arm them in Negotiations → Settings.

draft.exists: A draft order from this negotiation exists.
draft.ordered: An order was placed from this negotiation.

runs.hint: Every plan, dry run, write and error of the draft order and cart writers.

settings.counterHint: How the team prices whole-cart negotiations, and when a price needs a confirmation.
settings.cartModesHint: Changing it does not touch counter-offers already sent.

modes.both: Both: one amount or a price per line

settings.maxDiscountHint: Empty: no limit. A deeper discount shows a warning and needs a confirmation.
settings.discountInvalid: Enter a percentage between 0 and 100, e.g. 12,5.
settings.writersHint: Off by default. Each needs its option in medusa-config and a person arming it here.

writer.draft_ordersHint: The team creates a Medusa draft order at the agreed price (plan, dry run, write).
writer.cartHint: The customer adds the agreed lines to their cart at the agreed price through the Store API.

settings.optionOff: Off in medusa-config: set {{option}}: true to allow arming it.
settings.demoNoWrites: Demo mode is on: nothing is written.
settings.expiryOn: A thread with no move for {{days}} days expires (internal notes do not count).
settings.acceptedDays: An agreed price can be used for {{days}} days.
settings.optionsHint: Read-only. Change them in medusa-config.ts and restart Medusa.

guide.what: Signed-in B2B customers ask for a price for a product, a variant or a whole cart. The team answers in one thread: a reply, a counter-offer with its own deadline, an acceptance, a rejection with a reason, or an internal note. The agreed price can become a draft order or go into the customer's cart, exactly once.

install.title: Install the plugin
install.body: npm install, then add it to plugins in medusa-config.ts.

migrations.title: Run the migrations
migrations.body: npx medusa db:migrate creates the negotiation tables.

groups.title: Choose who may negotiate
groups.body: allowedCustomerGroups: {{count}} group(s) set, {{missing}} not found. Empty lets every signed-in customer negotiate.

storefront.title: Add the storefront screens
storefront.body: “Ask for a price” on the product and cart pages and a negotiations page in the account, on the Store API. Done once the first real request arrives.

floors.title: Set minimum prices
floors.body: In the variant's “Minimum price” widget. Prices below it need a confirmation and are never shown to customers.

events.title: Connect e-mails, CRM or ERP
events.body: Subscribe to negotiation.* events. Use only the payload's customer field in customer e-mails.

expiry.title: Check expiry
expiry.body: Threads expire after {{days}} days without a move (0 = never). The job runs every hour.

draft_orders.title: Draft orders (optional)
draft_orders.body: Set writers.draftOrders: true, then arm it in Settings.

cart.title: Agreed price in the cart (optional)
cart.body: Set writers.cart: true, then arm it in Settings. The storefront calls add-to-cart.

production.title: Go live
production.body: Switch demo mode off and restart Medusa.

guide.promptHint: Paste it into Claude Code, Cursor or another assistant in your Medusa backend project.

floorWidget.hint: Internal: never shown to customers. A counter-offer or acceptance below it shows a warning with the difference and needs a confirmation.
floorWidget.invalid: Each row needs a 3-letter currency and an amount such as 129,00.
